name: Tsukuri Design Office
description: Tsukuri Design Office is a calm portfolio theme for industrial and product design studios that take consumer products and medical devices from foam model to factory. A flat pale mauve-grey title strip holds the heading while a high-key studio photograph crosses into the stage below; problem, method and product rows use a narrow name block beside a measured paragraph, and proof is shown as equal twin photographs. A single white pill menu, a dark statement band and one way to start a project complete the home page. Inter Tight and IBM Plex Sans, high-key photography, quiet scroll effects.
